# FinSight ML Model Card

*This file will be auto-generated by the training pipeline (`backend/ml/train.py`).*

## Overview
This model card documents the machine learning models used in FinSight for transaction categorization and fraud detection.

## Models

### 1. Transaction Categorization
- **Type:** TF-IDF + Logistic Regression
- **Purpose:** Automatic categorization of transactions from payee/notes text
- **Categories:** 11 (Income, Food & Dining, Transport, Rent, Education, Subscriptions, Shopping, Entertainment, Health, Savings, Other)
- **Fallback:** Rule-based keyword matching (in `CategorizationService`)

### 2. Fraud Detection
- **Type:** Isolation Forest (Unsupervised Anomaly Detection)
- **Purpose:** Real-time anomaly scoring of transactions
- **Contamination:** 2%
- **Features:** 10 features (amount, user stats, payee/category novelty, time, velocity)
- **Risk Levels:** High (≥0.7), Medium (0.4-0.7), Low (<0.4)

## Training
Run the training pipeline:
```bash
cd backend/ml
python train.py
```

## Model Artifacts
Models are saved as `.joblib` files in `backend/ml/models/`:
- `categorizer.joblib`
- `fraud_detector.joblib`

## Monitoring
- Retrain monthly or when drift detected
- Monitor prediction distributions
- Collect user feedback on flagged transactions
